def build_real_governor_payload(*, source_row: Dict[str, Any], model_input_json: Dict[str, Any], finmo_json: Dict[str, Any], parse_json_object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  ops_json = parse_json_object(source_row.get("operating_model_json"))
  target_market_json = parse_json_object(source_row.get("target_market_json"))
  people_json = parse_json_object(source_row.get("people_json"))
  financials_json = parse_json_object(source_row.get("financials_json"))
  financials_year1_json = parse_json_object(source_row.get("financials_year1_json"))
  fulfillment_json = parse_json_object(source_row.get("fulfillment_json"))
  marketing_model_json = parse_json_object(source_row.get("marketing_model_json"))

  # Instead of passing raw modes or baseline summaries that may leak authority, build a safe sanitized context
  baseline_summary = _baseline_summary_from_finmo_json(finmo_json) or {}

  # Apply explicit no-authority instruction for later quarters to prevent baseline leakage
  planning_mode = determine_planning_mode(
    ops_json=ops_json,
    target_market_json=target_market_json,
    people_json=people_json,
    financials_json=financials_json,
    financials_year1_json=financials_year1_json,
    fulfillment_json=fulfillment_json,
    marketing_model_json=marketing_model_json,
    model_input_json=model_input_json,
    finmo_json=finmo_json,
  )

  # Below message added to the final planner prompt to explicitly disallow baseline authority in Q2-Q20
  non_authority_later_quarters = (
    "Later-quarter baseline values (Q2 through Q20) are placeholders and must NEVER be treated as authoritative or fixed constraints. "
    "Override these placeholders when realism, strategic cash posture, or baby-AI cash constraints require it."
  )

  # Normally would include more context here for baby AI cash posture and strategy

  return {
    "ops_json": ops_json,
    "target_market_json": target_market_json,
    "people_json": people_json,
    "financials_json": financials_json,
    "financials_year1_json": financials_year1_json,
    "fulfillment_json": fulfillment_json,
    "marketing_model_json": marketing_model_json,
    "model_input_json": model_input_json,
    "finmo_json": finmo_json,
    "baseline_summary": _sanitize_canonical_live_payload(baseline_summary),
    "planning_mode": planning_mode.get("planning_mode"),
    "non_authority_later_quarters_message": non_authority_later_quarters,
  }
